column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 Pandemonium / residents, merchants, and innkeeper
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What do you people want...? If you want information, hand over some money.
Doing anything in this city takes piles of money...
We can no longer make a living here.
This is the city of $$パンデモニウム$$! I told you, so pay up.
I am busy, so quit bothering me. Or... do you need a favor?!
Then I will make it cheap for you!!
Everything I sell is expensive! Come on, buy, buy!
Buying cheap and selling high—that is good business!
Business is like a drum!
Strike it hard and it booms; tap it lightly and it only makes a puny sound!!
Even if the deal is a little risky, if you flinch there, you will never make a profit...
Pay me enough, and I will sell even $$奴隷$$s!!
Twenty or thirty percent over is standard—our customer-appreciation sale has everything marked up one hundred or two hundred percent~!!
So, how about it? Will you buy something too?!
My goods are cheap!!
But they are sold out.
What, what are you people...?! Ah!
Are you staying at my place? The lodging charge is...
every bit of money you have!!
In this city, money is everything...
No matter how strong you are, you cannot get by in this city without money!
Things used to be a little easier for us $$奴隷$$s, but...
since the new $$領主$$ came, it has been awful...!
The people in this city must enter the gambling held in the $$闘技場$$ every weekend...
without fail...
and there, $$マモン$$ squeezes most people out of nearly all the money they earned that week...
Ah, I am busy...
You see that grand mansion in the middle of town, like a palace?!
That is the estate of the new $$領主$$, $$マモン$$!!
It seems $$マモン$$ uses his money to hire a great many warriors!
Maybe he would hire people like you for high pay!!
